scenario.name: r-cd-collection-on-collapse-producer
scenario.description: Live producer: A→detached session-mode B→delayed C. Default one-parent return: C must reach A after B terminalizes. fanoutMode=tree is a distinct ancestry-return control and is not this fire.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: A spawns detached session-mode B; B schedules delayed C then terminalizes; C returns to A (default one-parent, do not set fanoutMode). Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted for the A→B→C producer

expectedReceipts.name: root-collection-after-intermediate-finalized
expectedReceipts.description: Root A observes C-DONE sentinel after B terminalizes; not B-only and not orphan

expectedReceipts.name: no-orphan-or-b-only-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: Negative guard: C return is not orphaned and not delivered only to B

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id for Tempo join of the producer run

review.notes: Live producer for collection-on-collapse. Historical static PASS packets are fixtures only. Default one-parent return, not fanoutMode=tree. Diagnostic unless runtime SHA is the exact final successor. Never promote from static-corpus-row-validator.

census.limits: Only 8 continuation.work entry spans were accepted fleet-wide in 24h (182 in 7d). This row’s trace receipt joins the continue_work tool span to continuation.work and continuation.work.fire by shared trace, which is the only join available: the entry span carries no origin, session, turn, or run identity, and there is no proof marker separating this row’s fire from an organic one.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The wake reason is published as a digest and a length. The raw reason, the wake sentinel instruction body, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: A, detached B, and delayed C identities are retained; C reaches A after B terminalizes.
controls.negative: B-only delivery, orphan C, or fanoutMode=tree must not satisfy this row.
controls.notes: Deploy-persistence, the second half of this row’s historical scope, has no telemetry expression at all and rests on chain-counter observation.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded Tempo makes the trace receipt unavailable. That is receipt debt, not evidence that no wake occurred.

verdictAuthority.pass: Dispatch accepted, observable scheduled tool result, wake event, and a trace receipt. Behavioral only.
verdictAuthority.partial: The trace receipt is missing or the backend is degraded or partial; a disposable-session run that stops at scheduled-only is PARTIAL, never PASS.
verdictAuthority.fail: The scheduled sentinel appears without a wake, or the wake fires without an accepted schedule.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-collection-on-collapse-producer.js is the live producer; static-corpus-row-validator is a consumer only.
execution.manual: Per-seat cross-walk fires remain manual and file under the row’s canonical path.
execution.relationship: Deterministic k6 is the verdict authority; manual cross-walks add seat coverage only.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live A→B→C producer. Prefer disposable session. Diagnostic if seat runtime is not the exact candidate. Static validator is not this producer.
